$comment: Build log. Add an entry only when the thing has actually happened. Never edit dates. Times are UTC. proof.label names the receipt (commit hash, post, tx); proof.href is added once it is publicly reachable.

entries.title: Project started
entries.detail: Empty folder. Idea: a meme coin about a receipt that only prints what it can prove.

entries.title: Name picked: CHEK ($CHEK)
entries.detail: First draft was RECEIPTS / $RCPT. A name check found the ticker already in use, so we renamed before publishing anything. Чек = receipt. The check = the bill. Check = what you should do.

correction.note: Ticker changed later the same day: the token symbol is CHEKD (see the 23:15 UTC entry). The brand stays CHEK. This entry is kept as it was recorded.

entries.title: Mascot drawn
entries.detail: Chek exists: 7 expressions, 6 poses, drawn as code so every image comes from one source.

entries.title: Website v0 deployed
entries.detail: chekcoin.vercel.app claimed. Static site, contract shown as NOT LAUNCHED YET.

entries.title: Brand system + villains
entries.detail: Logo mark, avatars, X header, token image, OG card, meme kit. Two villains join the lore: The Shredder and The Coupon.

entries.title: Website v1
entries.detail: Transparency page, meme kit, 404. Every section of the receipt is live.

entries.title: Pump.fun facts checked
entries.detail: Fees, limits and token settings re-checked against Pump.fun docs and fresh mainnet mints. Creator fee (0.30% of curve trades) disclosed in Tokenomics.

entries.title: Content bank ready
entries.detail: 26 X posts, 11 Telegram posts, 10 memes, 5 mascot images, a reaction GIF. Nothing posted yet — posts go out on schedule, starting when the accounts open.

entries.title: Launch-minute rehearsal
entries.detail: Full dry run of publishing a contract address on a real pump.fun coin in a throwaway copy (nothing published). It caught a bug in our tooling; fixed.

entries.title: Pre-launch checklist
entries.detail: Automatic pre-launch check at 20:10 UTC: 27 passed, 6 waiting on the owner (X, Telegram ×2, GitHub, launch time, uncommitted files), 0 failed.

correction.note: Wording clarified. It first said “27 automatic checks pass”; the owner report later said 28 — that was a re-run after the final commit. Date unchanged.

entries.title: Audit pass before the first post
entries.detail: External audit applied: tokens that already use the name or ticker are now called “not affiliated”, not “fake”; “a name or ticker is not proof” added everywhere; X/Telegram status, counters and dates made consistent by an automatic audit; platform values marked “as checked”. Pre-launch check at 21:30 UTC: 35 passed, 8 waiting on the owner, 0 failed (of 43).

entries.title: Autopilot foundation
entries.detail: Backend for receipts, a content queue with owner approvals, code-level content guards (unknown addresses, price promises, “fake” labels are blocked), a news desk that only drafts claims it can quote from the source, and an on-chain watcher. Built and tested; not connected to any account yet — nothing is published by it.

entries.title: Receipt Board
entries.detail: Every project action as a numbered receipt: on-chain verified ones link to the transaction, project-reported ones say so. Plus the Creator Receipt on the transparency page, filled from the creation transaction at launch.

entries.title: Receipt images
entries.detail: Receipts render as images (four formats) with real, scannable barcodes. A reported receipt is never styled as verified.

entries.title: Pre-launch check
entries.detail: Automatic pre-launch check at 22:21 UTC: 36 passed, 12 waiting on the owner, 0 failed (of 48).

entries.title: Ticker decided: $CHEKD
entries.detail: The brand stays CHEK; the token symbol becomes CHEKD. Our name check (01 Oct 2026) found about ninety unrelated Pump.fun tokens already using the shorter ticker, so we added a letter instead of sharing a crowded symbol. Those tokens are not affiliated with this project.

entries.title: X and Telegram linked
entries.detail: Official X: @chekcoinsol — an existing account of the founder, renamed and repurposed for CHEK. It was not created for CHEK, so its join date is older than this project. Official Telegram channel: t.me/chekcoinsol (CHEK | Official), with our bot @chekcoinsol_bot as admin. Nothing has been posted yet.

entries.title: Receipt Generator live
entries.detail: Anyone can print a receipt for any claim at /print and share it on X — no wallet, no sign-up. The same printer answers in Telegram (@chekcoinsol_bot). Visitor receipts say “printed by a visitor · not a statement by CHEK” and can never carry a VERIFIED stamp.

entries.title: Autopilot connected — 24 h dry run
entries.detail: Database, scheduler (every 5 minutes) and Telegram are connected. For 24 hours the system runs exactly as it would live but publishes nothing: every post it would have published and every post its guards rejected is logged. Nothing goes out before the owner reviews that report.

entries.title: Canonical domain: www.chekcoinsol.xyz
entries.detail: The official website moved to https://www.chekcoinsol.xyz. chekcoin.vercel.app keeps working; every other domain only redirects here.

entries.title: Repository public on GitHub
entries.detail: The full source and build history are public. Before publication the history was rewritten for privacy — personal paths, hosting ids, location, time-zone offsets and a placeholder author name were removed; commit messages and moments were kept. A first published version was replaced a few minutes later (author name, co-author lines). The hashes in this log are the published ones.

entries.title: Pre-launch posting starts
entries.detail: The autopilot is live before the token: X posts are handed to the owner in Telegram and posted by hand, the Telegram channel posts on its own. The dry run ran 10 hours without errors and was ended early at the owner’s request (planned: 24 hours). Six short CHEK videos made for the first posts. General crypto news is switched off — CHEK talks about CHEK.

entries.title: Receipt Drop opened
entries.detail: Part of the creator’s own launch buy goes to the community: the first 500 entries get 10,000 $CHEKD each, and 100 random entries get 100,000 each (1.5% of supply in total), only if $CHEKD launches. Entry in Telegram, one per account; the draw runs 24 h after launch with a published Solana blockhash as the seed; every transfer will be published as an on-chain receipt.

entries.title: Drop split: main drop on X, separate drop in Telegram
entries.detail: Before any drop post went out and with 0 entries, the drop was split in two. X drop (main): the first 300 entries get 10,000 $CHEKD each, plus a draw of 70 × 100,000; entry = a reply to @chekcoinsol with a public Solana address, checked from its public link at /drop. Telegram drop (separate list): the first 200 entries × 10,000 plus a draw of 30 × 100,000. Still 15M $CHEKD (1.5% of supply) in total from the creator’s own launch buy, only if $CHEKD launches.

entries.title: X drop in rounds
entries.detail: Before the first X drop post went out: instead of one shared draw, every X drop post is its own round — 5 random replies under that post get 70,000 $CHEKD each (20 rounds, 7M), and the first 300 accounts get 10,000 each (3M). The site reads the round number from the post a reply is under. The Telegram drop and the 15M total (1.5% of supply) are unchanged.

entries.title: X rounds drawn 24 h after each post
entries.detail: Before round 1 closed: each X round now closes 24 hours after its post and is drawn right away — seed = the blockhash of the first Solana block at or after the close, the lowest sha256(blockhash:address) scores win. Winners are announced on X, in Telegram and on /drop, where anyone can re-run the draw in the browser. Tokens are sent after $CHEKD launches. The Telegram drop is still drawn 24 hours after launch.
